evals.name: resolves-and-runs-the-binary
evals.prompt: Set up docs-hygiene for this repo. /docs-hygiene:setup
evals.expected_output: Resolves markdownlint-cli2 from PATH or the repository's node_modules/.bin, runs it with --version, and reports a PASS row naming which one resolved. Installs nothing and writes nothing.
expectations: Probes PATH first and node_modules/.bin under the repository root second
Runs the resolved binary with --version rather than treating resolution alone as a pass
Writes no file and runs no install command

evals.name: missing-binary-reports-remediation
evals.prompt: compress stopped and said markdownlint-cli2 is missing. Run the docs-hygiene setup and fix it for me.
evals.expected_output: Reports FAIL for the missing binary with the explicit install remediation, names that compress stops at its entry point without it, and does not install anything itself.
expectations: Reports a FAIL row with the install remediation (npm install --save-dev markdownlint-cli2 or a global install)
Does not run npm, npx, or any download on the operator's behalf
Does not offer apply as a fix for the missing binary

evals.name: broken-shim-is-a-fail
evals.prompt: /docs-hygiene:setup check. node_modules/.bin/markdownlint-cli2 exists but our Node install was removed.
evals.expected_output: Reports FAIL because the resolved shim exits non-zero under --version, carries the execution error in the remediation line, and does not claim the prerequisite is met.
expectations: Treats a resolved shim that fails --version as FAIL
Includes the execution error text in the remediation line
Does not claim success from resolution alone

evals.name: check-reports-effective-compress-articles
evals.prompt: /docs-hygiene:setup check [markdownlint-cli2 resolves on PATH and prints its version. The repository has no docs/conventions/docs-hygiene.yaml. The docs-hygiene userConfig option compress_articles is set to cut, so the skill's userConfig line substitutes to cut.]
evals.expected_output: PASS rows for markdownlint-cli2 resolution and its --version run. setup-apply.mjs --check prints an INFO line that docs/conventions/docs-hygiene.yaml is absent. The effective compress_articles is cut, supplied by userConfig. Nothing is written.
expectations: Runs setup-apply.mjs --check and reports the absent repository file as INFO, not WARN or FAIL
States compress_articles as cut and names userConfig as the supplying layer
Writes no file and edits no settings file

evals.name: apply-shows-diff-before-changing-existing-file
evals.prompt: /docs-hygiene:setup apply compress_articles=cut [The repository already has a tracked docs/conventions/docs-hygiene.yaml holding compress_articles: keep. The operator has not yet seen any diff.]
evals.expected_output: Runs check, then setup-apply.mjs compress_articles=cut, which exits 3 and prints a unified diff from keep to cut without writing. The skill shows that diff and asks the operator whether to write it; it re-runs with --yes only after an explicit yes, then re-runs check and reports the value it reads back.
expectations: Shows the unified diff from keep to cut before anything is written
Does not pass --yes until the operator explicitly agrees to that diff
After the write, re-runs check and reports the value from check, not from the write

evals.name: apply-refuses-a-file-needing-a-hand-edit
evals.prompt: /docs-hygiene:setup apply compress_articles=keep [docs/conventions/docs-hygiene.yaml sets compress_articles twice: once to keep and once to cut.]
evals.expected_output: check reports a WARN that compress_articles is set 2 times. setup-apply.mjs refuses with one line, exits 1 and leaves the file untouched, because a key set twice needs a hand edit first. The skill reports the refusal and asks the operator to remove one of the two lines; it does not edit the file itself.
expectations: Reports the duplicate key as a WARN naming the file and the key
Reports that apply refused and the file is unchanged
Does not edit docs/conventions/docs-hygiene.yaml by hand or with another tool to work around the refusal

evals.name: check-invalid-repo-value-resolves-to-default-not-userconfig
evals.prompt: /docs-hygiene:setup check [markdownlint-cli2 resolves on PATH and prints its version. docs/conventions/docs-hygiene.yaml holds compress_articles: drop. The docs-hygiene userConfig option compress_articles is set to cut, so SKILL.md's userConfig line substitutes to cut.]
evals.expected_output: setup-apply.mjs --check prints a WARN naming docs/conventions/docs-hygiene.yaml, compress_articles and drop, then WARN compress_articles: dropped. The repository layer is the highest, so with it dropped no valid layer sits above it, and the effective compress_articles is keep from the default, the value /docs-hygiene:compress resolves for the same files. The userConfig value cut is not used. Nothing is written.
expectations: Reports a WARN that names docs/conventions/docs-hygiene.yaml, the key compress_articles and the value drop
States the effective compress_articles as keep from the default
Does not report cut from userConfig as the effective value
Writes nothing
